scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p server/public && cp -r client/dist/. server/public/ && cd server && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && (chmod +x node_modules/.prisma/client/*.node node_modules/@prisma/engines/* node_modules/prisma/*.so.node 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.postbuild: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy || true
